tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default background for content panes, forms, lists and dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Application background behind panes; alternate list rows.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Table headers, toolbars, read-only field backgrounds, 'Previous values' panels.

tokens.name: surface-reveal
tokens.usage: Shading shared by a reveal control and the fields it reveals (CNA-1030/1040, about 25% grey screening).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and data values on surface, surface-sunken, surface-muted and surface-reveal.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Field labels and secondary text on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: In-field prompt text (italic) and help text below fields, on surface and surface-sunken only.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control text. Exempt from contrast minimums; never used for data.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers between rows and panes. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and button borders: at least 3:1 on surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, selected tab underline and current-time markers.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent fills and links.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-surface
tokens.usage: Selected rows, selected list items and advisory (blue) panels.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset, on every surface.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover highlight on clickable rows and editable entries (CUI yellow hover convention, CNA-0740).

tokens.name: banner
tokens.usage: Patient banner background. Dark so the banner is always distinguishable from application content.

tokens.name: on-banner
tokens.usage: Patient name and values on banner.

tokens.name: on-banner-muted
tokens.usage: Banner field labels (Born, Gender, NHS No.) on banner.

tokens.name: banner-divider
tokens.usage: Divider between the banner's demographic and clinical zones.

tokens.name: banner-alert
tokens.usage: Fill of the allergy/alert badge inside the patient banner; its text uses the banner colour.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, prohibition symbols, allergy and ADR risk headings. Red means no-go, error or alarm.

tokens.name: danger-surface
tokens.usage: Background of error messages and high-severity alerts; text on it uses ink or danger.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger fills (allergy badge).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution text and icon strokes. Yellow means marginal or cautionary.

tokens.name: warning-fill
tokens.usage: Warning triangle fill (always with black #000000 border and black pictogram).

tokens.name: warning-surface
tokens.usage: Background of caution alerts and the 'Nil by mouth' banner.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Given/completed states and acceptable values. Always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: success-surface
tokens.usage: Background for completed administration cells and success messages.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Advisory information (blue). Never used for high-importance items.

tokens.name: info-surface
tokens.usage: Background of advisory panels and info alerts.

tokens.name: encodable
tokens.usage: Pale blue highlight on text that can be encoded in SNOMED CT; same tint for suggested matches. Never green or red.

tokens.name: confirmed
tokens.usage: Grey background of confirmed coded terms in the encoding editor.

tokens.name: mandatory-symbol
tokens.usage: Blue fill of the mandatory-action circle symbol, with white pictogram.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: First graph series (blue is allocated first, GTAB guidance).

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Second graph series (red).

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Third graph series (yellow/amber); always with a distinct marker shape.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Fourth graph series (green), distinct marker shape.

tokens.name: normal-range
tokens.usage: Shaded normal-range band behind graph series.

styles.name: patient-name
styles.usage: Patient name in the banner: FAMILY name upper case, Given name, (Title).

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Pane and dialog headings. Sentence case.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Section and group headings inside panes.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Data values, list rows, medication lines and form controls.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Drug names in medication lines and confirmed coded terms during entry.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels in banners and LabelledValue pairs.

styles.name: prompt
styles.usage: Help text below fields and in-field prompts, in ink-subtle.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Observation values in tables; use tabular figures so decimal points align.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value; icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Control padding; gap between inline fields.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in lists and tables.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Pane padding; gap between banner zones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between form sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between major page regions.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, checkboxes, chips and table cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, popovers, alerts and suggested-match boxes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and floating panels.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers, flyouts, calendar picker and drop-down results.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs.
